unit.why: A single narrative about the rabbi of Bardichev (מבא"ד) on Yom Kippur: he falls to the ground in devekut during the Musaf service, appears dead, and later returns in fervor to complete the prayer.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי בשמו ממגידי אמת מי ששמע
stories.summary_en: On Yom Kippur, during the Avodah in Musaf at 'and thus he would count: one', the rabbi of Bardichev fell to the ground in devekut and seemed truly dead, even to doctors. He was carried to his room, but at Ne'ilah he suddenly ran back into the study hall to the prayer stand, cried 'and one', and went on praying in order.

tags.why: Set on Yom Kippur during the High Holy Days

quotes: בעת העבודה בתפלת מוסף באמרו וכך הי׳ מונה אחת
